name: @dropins/mcp

tools.name: analyze_project
tools.description: Analyze a merchant storefront project: detect installed dropins, blocks, config, and versions

projectDir.description: Absolute path to the merchant storefront project root

tools.name: list_slots
tools.description: AUTHORITATIVE source for slot data. List available slots for dropin containers with context shapes and examples. Use this instead of search tools for slot questions

dropin.description: Dropin name (e.g. storefront-cart). Omit to list all.

container.description: Container name (e.g. CartSummaryList). Requires dropin to be set.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: AUTHORITATIVE source for event data. List events emitted and consumed by dropins with payload shapes. Use this instead of search tools for event questions

dropin.description: Filter events by dropin name (e.g. storefront-cart)

direction.description: Filter by direction: emitted, consumed, or all (default: all)

tools.name: list_containers
tools.description: AUTHORITATIVE source for container data. List available dropin containers with props and slot names. Use this instead of search tools for container questions

dropin.description: Filter by dropin name (e.g. storefront-cart). Omit to list all.

tools.name: list_api_functions
tools.description: AUTHORITATIVE source for API function data. List available API functions for dropins with signatures. Use this instead of search tools for API questions

dropin.description: Filter by dropin name (e.g. storefront-cart). Omit to list all.

tools.name: list_design_tokens
tools.description: List design tokens (CSS custom properties) for theming

category.description: Token category: colors, typography, spacing, shapes, grid. Omit to list all.

tools.name: list_i18n_keys
tools.description: List i18n dictionary keys and their default English values, filterable by dropin and substring query on key path or value

dropin.description: Filter to a specific dropin (e.g. "storefront-checkout"). Omit to search across all dropins.

query.description: Substring filter applied to both key paths and values (e.g. "email" matches Checkout.LoginForm.invalidEmailError and its value). Case-insensitive.

containerName.description: Filter to keys used by a specific container (e.g. "MiniCart"). Derived from the second segment of the dot-notation key path.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: Look up TypeScript interface and type definitions (CartModel, Price, Item, etc.) used in event payloads and slot contexts. Use when a payloadType or contextType references a named model you need to understand.

dropin.description: Filter models by dropin name (e.g. storefront-cart)

model.description: Find a specific model by name (e.g. CartModel, Price, Item). Returns full definition.

tools.name: list_init_config
tools.description: AUTHORITATIVE source for initializer config. List configuration parameters accepted by a dropin's initialize() function, including name, type, required flag, and description. Use when setting up a dropin or checking what options are available.

dropin.description: Filter by dropin name (e.g. storefront-auth). Omit to list all dropins and their init config parameters.

tools.name: check_config
tools.description: Validate a merchant storefront project configuration

projectDir.description: Absolute path to the merchant storefront project root

tools.name: scaffold_block
tools.description: Generate a new AEM block with dropin containers. Supports single dropin (dropin + containers) or multi-dropin (containersByDropin) with automatic provider aliases.

blockName.description: Block name (e.g. commerce-custom-cart). Will be used as folder and file name.

containers.description: Container names for single-dropin mode (e.g. ["CartSummaryList", "OrderSummary"]). Requires dropin.

dropin.description: Primary dropin for single-dropin mode (e.g. storefront-cart). Requires containers.

containersByDropin.description: Multi-dropin mode: map of dropin to containers, e.g. { "storefront-cart": ["MiniCart"], "storefront-wishlist": ["WishlistToggle"] }

slots.description: Slots per container. Use "ContainerName" when unique, or "dropin/ContainerName" when the same container name exists in multiple dropins. E.g. { "CartSummaryList": ["Thumbnail"], "storefront-cart/EstimateShipping": ["Header"] }

withEvents.description: Include event bus wiring boilerplate (default: false)

projectDir.description: Absolute path to the merchant storefront project root

tools.name: scaffold_slot
tools.description: Generate production-ready slot implementation boilerplate for a specific container slot, including imports, context destructuring, and all available slot methods

dropin.description: Dropin package name (e.g. "storefront-cart"). Provide to resolve ambiguity when the same slot name exists in multiple dropins.

projectDir.description: Absolute path to the merchant storefront project root

tools.name: suggest_slot_implementation
tools.description: Suggest slot implementation code for a UI customization request on an existing block

request.description: What the merchant wants (e.g. "Add loyalty points badge next to price in cart")

projectDir.description: Absolute path to the merchant storefront project root

tools.name: suggest_event_handler
tools.description: Suggest event handler code for a cross-dropin behavior request

request.description: What the merchant wants (e.g. "Show popup when order is placed", "Refresh mini-cart when product is added")

projectDir.description: Absolute path to the merchant storefront project root

tools.name: explain_event_flow
tools.description: Trace the full lifecycle of an event: who emits it, who consumes it, payload type, and ready-to-use listen and emit code. Supports exact, prefix, and substring matching.

eventName.description: Exact or partial event name to look up (e.g. "cart/data", "cart", "order/placed"). Prefix matching is supported: "cart" matches all cart/* events.

dropin.description: Filter results to events emitted or consumed by a specific dropin (e.g. "storefront-cart").

tools.name: get_upgrade_diff
tools.description: Compare merchant dropin versions against registry and show containers, slots, and migration notes

projectDir.description: Absolute path to the merchant storefront project root

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search local documentation snapshots, SDK packages, code examples, and GraphQL operations. For API data, prefer dedicated tools first (list_slots, list_containers, etc). Use this for cross-cutting searches or working code examples

query.description: Search query (e.g. "CORS setup", "cart slots", "payment method integration")

section.description: Limit search to a specific section (e.g. "setup", "dropins/cart", "merchants")

maxResults.description: Maximum total results to return across all sources combined (default: 10). Each source is searched independently and the top results are selected from the combined pool.

includeContent.description: Include full page content in results (default: false, returns snippets)

tools.name: search_commerce_docs
tools.description: AI-powered semantic search for conceptual documentation: guides, tutorials, best practices, architecture. Optional enhancement requiring aio CLI authentication. NOT for API definitions (slots, events, containers) — use registry tools instead

query.description: Natural language search query (e.g. "how to add a custom payment method", "CORS configuration for storefront")

maxResults.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 5)

tools.name: list_graphql_queries
tools.description: AUTHORITATIVE source for GraphQL operations. List queries, mutations, and extensible fragments used by dropins with full resolved source and extensibility metadata

dropin.description: Filter by dropin name (e.g. storefront-cart). Omit to list all.

type.description: Filter by operation type: query or mutation.

name.description: Search by operation or fragment name (case-insensitive substring match).

tools.name: check_block_health
tools.description: Check a merchant's AEM block against the current registry. Detects containers, slots, events, and API functions that no longer exist or have been renamed. Omit the block parameter to scan all dropin blocks and their initializer files at once. Pass fix: true to get a concrete rename or remove hint for every finding.

projectDir.description: Absolute path to the merchant's AEM project root (e.g. aem-boilerplate-commerce)

block.description: Block directory name, e.g. "commerce-cart", "product-details". Omit to scan all blocks that use dropins.

fix.description: When true, each finding includes a concrete fix suggestion: the closest valid replacement or a removal hint.

stderr: Dropins MCP Server running on stdio
